scopeNote: Buses (First West Yorkshire, Arriva Yorkshire, Transdev) and West Yorkshire Metro light rail are EXCLUDED from this catalog. Buses have static-only GTFS via the DFT aggregator with no confirmed public real-time feed (report §V1 scoping, C2/C3 point 6) — deferred to a later wave per the report's own instruction. West Yorkshire Metro light rail is a planning-stage mass-transit project (Strategic Outline Case published March 2024) with no passenger rail lines open yet (report C2/C3 point 8) — there is no network to catalog. If bus real-time emerges or WY Metro opens, either needs its own oracle-clash pass and Luke pack, not a retrofit of this file. See jim-handoff.md.
notes: D1 oracle is docs/west-yorkshire-d1/oracle-clash-report.md only. No product lib/cities/west-yorkshire/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file. No UK-country ledger exists yet (docs/*-ledger.md glob has only denmark-ledger.md) — this pack proceeds without one, same basis as East Midlands / South Wales / South Yorkshire.
One agency in scope: National Rail. No parent/child agency structure (unlike South Wales' Valley Lines pairing or South Yorkshire's Supertram pairing) — see hazard-pack.md H1.

National Rail modes v1: heavy rail, destination-board model (not line+terminus). BLOCKED pending DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN — see coverageGaps. Build the catalog/adapter normally per Nico's report; do not wire the token until it exists.

Hub lock: Leeds Station (LDS CRS), 18 platforms (0-17), Network Rail. Secondary hub: Bradford Forster Square (BDQ CRS). Bradford Interchange (BDI CRS) is a separate station, walk-link only to BDQ, not a merge — doNotGroup applies. See hazard-pack.md H6.
doNotGroup: Leeds Station National Rail platforms vs. bus/coach interchange (report C2/C3 point 3) — forward note only, bus is out of scope so nothing exists yet to group against.

doNotGroup: Bradford Forster Square (BDQ) vs. Bradford Interchange (BDI) — separate infrastructure, walk-link connect only (report C2/C3 point 2). Both are catalog entries here since BDI also carries National Rail (Northern Trains) service, not just bus.

Denby Dale (DDL CRS) is a through-running-only boundary station shared with South Yorkshire's own catalog (docs/south-yorkshire-d1/published-network.json already lists it, CRS left null there, 'do not guess'). This pack supplies the CRS code (DDL) per this report's own station table (line 20) — NOT resolved as a merge or ownership decision between the two regions' catalogs; flagged as an open D2 de-dup item in both packs now. See hazard-pack.md.

Walsden (WAD CRS) is a through-running-only boundary station toward Greater Manchester. No Greater Manchester D1 pack exists yet to cross-check against (still account-blocked/unpacked). Flagged for future de-dup once Greater Manchester is packed.

City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until National Rail is unblocked, same as every other UK National Rail region packed so far.

No 'lines' array is provided for National Rail — no printed route/line map to transcribe, same as every National Rail-only region packed so far. This is a flat station list (two hubs, through-running boundary points, regional stations).

License: OGL 2.0 baseline with NRE amendments for Darwin. Confidence 'unclear' on third-party rider redistribution — same open item as every other UK National Rail region. Bus GTFS (DFT aggregator) is OGL 3.0, confidence 'clear', but is reference-only since buses are out of v1 scope.

BOARD ELIGIBILITY GAP: the oracle report has no 'Board eligibility' section (docs/board-eligibility-rule.md requirement, adopted 30 Aug 2026). This pack does not fabricate verdicts to fill that gap. See coverageGaps and jim-handoff.md — Mark's QA gate will need this resolved (a Nico follow-up pass, not a Luke guess) before a flip-PR, exactly the same requirement that applies once National Rail unblocks.

printedInnerCityNames.note: Leeds Station (LDS) is the sole primary hub lock (report C2/C3 point 1: 'Leeds Station (LDS) is the hub lock, rail only; bus connections at separate interchange'). Bradford Forster Square (BDQ) is a secondary hub, distinct from Bradford Interchange (BDI) — do not conflate the two Bradford stations under one printed name. See hazard-pack.md H6.

coverageGaps: National Rail real-time: OpenLDBWS documented and technically live, but BLOCKED at the account level (AU-registered RDM account; Tim re-registering with UK address). Not a feed problem. Do not wire DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN until it exists. Same blocker already accepted for every other UK National Rail region.

National Rail licensing: OGL 2.0 baseline permits redistribution with attribution, but the RDM Platform Agreement's language on downstream redistribution to third-party rider clients is UNCLEAR in public sources. Confidence: unclear (per oracle report License section). OPEN ITEM FOR TIM ONLY — do not resolve here.

BOARD ELIGIBILITY SECTION MISSING from the oracle report — docs/board-eligibility-rule.md requires every oracle-clash report to carry a Board eligibility section (verdict + evidence per service calling at an in-catalog station), or the explicit 'No services other than the in-scope operator...verified' sentence if empty. West Yorkshire's report has neither. This pack does not fabricate verdicts for Northern Trains / TransPennine Express services to fill the gap — that is Nico's job, not Luke's. FLAGGED FOR A NICO FOLLOW-UP PASS before Mark can gate a flip-PR on this city. See jim-handoff.md.

Buses (First West Yorkshire, Arriva Yorkshire, Transdev): static GTFS only via DFT aggregator, no confirmed public real-time endpoint found (report §V1 scoping). Deferred to a later wave per the report's own instruction; not modelled in this pack at all.

West Yorkshire Metro light rail: planning-stage mass-transit project (Strategic Outline Case published March 2024), no passenger rail lines open yet (report C2/C3 point 8). No network exists to catalog.
Denby Dale (DDL) cross-region de-dup with South Yorkshire's own catalog entry — NOT resolved in this pack. Flagged for D2/Jim in both regions' packs.
Walsden (WAD) cross-region de-dup with a future Greater Manchester pack — cannot be resolved yet since no Greater Manchester D1 pack exists.

National Rail has no printed route/line map to transcribe — no 'lines' array is provided, only the hub/secondary-hub/through-running/regional station list. See direction-model-memo.md for the destination+operator model recommended instead.

nationalRailStations.note: No printed route/line map exists for National Rail in the oracle report — Darwin is a per-station real-time board, not a fixed-route product. This is a flat station list, not a 'lines' array. BLOCKED pending DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN.
